title: Repos are shown in explore but not accessible if user visibility is limited
body:

## Description
<!-- If using a proxy or a CDN (e.g. CloudFlare) in front of gitea, please
     disable the proxy/CDN fully and connect to gitea directly to confirm
     the issue still persists without those services. -->

If I set my user visibility to limited, my repos are shown in the explore repos page (when loggen out), but if I try to open them, I get a 404 error.
...
